tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Lists what Infinite Option (infinite-option.com, Germany) manufactures from a customer CAD file: processes (3D printing, CNC, sheet metal) with the materials currently offered, accepted file formats, and where to get a price. Read-only.

tools.name: list_part_templates
tools.description: Lists the ready-made parametric parts of the Infinite CAD Builder (a CAD program that runs in the browser), with their adjustable dimensions and a link that opens each part in the builder. Read-only.

tools.name: get_builder_link
tools.description: Returns a link that opens the Infinite CAD Builder in the browser: empty, with a ready-made part (template), with one of its tools, or with a sentence already filled into its "Text zu 3D" input (the user still has to confirm it; nothing is executed by the link). tools.name: get_price_link
tools.description: Returns the link where a customer uploads a CAD file (STEP, STL, 3MF, DXF) to see prices and order online, plus the steps. This server does not calculate prices itself. Read-only.
